body: Used this app with my first 2 kids and it was such an amazing help. I'm expecting my 3rd baby soon and knew I wanted to use it again. I'm disappointed to find out it's a paid subscription now. I understand needing to make money to support what you created, but simply adding an ad or two, or giving an option to have a free version of the app would have been better than cutting off complete access behind a paywall.
developer_reply: Hi River! Good news: if you've already purchased the app, you don't have to pay again. Just contact us at support@thewonderweeks.com and we'll make sure you can continue using the app at no additional cost.

body: I already paid for your book and now you're telling me I have to pay a premium fee to access all of the information in the app?? If you don't subscribe you don't get all of the information and the app doesn't function completely for you. I'm not interested in paying for your content twice... I'll stick with the book I already own. Uninstalling. I get paying for premium app content and would do that but the app doesn't even offer full basic functions without pay. Not one feature fully works w/o $
developer_reply:
The app and the book are 2 separate and unique products that complement each other well with the theme of leaps.

The app is a complement to the book and makes itself user-friendly, but there are also more possibilities in the app that are missing in the book, you can add photos and notes and much more.

body: I like the info but IMO there is no reason this should be a subscription model and DEFINITELY not one as expensive as this when we're just interacting with information published in a $10 book. I paid for 3 months one time but decided to cancel and not financially support such a greedy model. I would absolutely have paid a one time cost and now rather than also buying the book I think I will forego the information entirely. If there's a reason for subscription it needs to be transparent.
developer_reply: Hi Shelby thank you for sharing your thoughts! We understand that pricing is important, and we’re always working to balance quality with affordability to ensure you feel you’re getting the best value.

body: Have to uninstall several times and reinstall several times a day just to change the number of oz for feeding.

I haven't seen an app which is more insisting on buying premium subscription, than Sprouty. After setting app for the first time you must subscribe for trial period, there was NO skip button, so there is a high chance that after 7 days you will forget about it (because yiu will be busy with your baby and everything around it), and the default option is one year plan. Questions for the first set up are not relevant for a newborn, but made to give you more premium functions.
